{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check shape
print(f"Shape of the dataset: {df.shape}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
customer_age_neg1 = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {customer_age_neg1}")

# Check revenue column
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')
revenue_nulls = df['revenue'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Number of invalid revenue values after conversion: {revenue_nulls}")

# Check for thousands separators in original revenue strings
thousands_separators = df['revenue'].str.contains(r',', regex=True).sum()
print(f"Number of revenue entries with thousands separators: {thousands_separators}")"}
